evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth at constant Ar flow: 2.90 -> 2.98 -> 3.04 -> 3.11 -> 3.18 Torr (k=20..24)
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow-setpoint effect
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with plausible heater power ~45%, so thermal control looks nominal
Sensor not installed per manifest; inert atmosphere / air ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or an equivalent leak check: Ar shut-off pressure-rise-rate test, or comparison of P against normal-run reference band) to distinguish a seal leak from partial exhaust blockage versus benign thermal/gauge drift.
